title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Short-Period Retention on Overlap Credits
content:
**Short-period retention.** Under the overlap schedule of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs**, when a certificate ends on confirmed borrower coverage, Tidemark keeps, without taking the overlap credit below zero, 100 dollars of it when the borrower's coverage started 1 to 60 days after the certificate's original start date on its issue entry, keeps 40 dollars when it started 61 to 180 days after that date, and keeps nothing otherwise.

The amount kept is taken off the overlap credit only once every amount added to the credit has been added, and it never takes the credit below zero.

The original start date is the coverage start on the certificate's issue entry, whatever renewals followed. The borrower's coverage start is the effective date on the borrower evidence. Days between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date excluded and the later date included.

| Borrower's coverage started, after the original start date | Kept by Tidemark |
|---|---|
| On the original start date or before it | Nothing |
| 1 to 60 days after | 100 dollars |
| 61 to 180 days after | 40 dollars |
| More than 180 days after | Nothing |

*Hypothetical:* an overlap credit of 70.00 dollars with 100 dollars to keep becomes 0.00 dollars, never a negative amount.
